description: Per-pair statuses of the 150 pairs behind the manuscript's PM6 / GFN2-xTB / RDKit rates, re-derived from the stored energies and a fresh RDKit scoring
row_grain: per-pair (one row per tautomer pair of the 150-pair PM6/xTB subset)

columns.name: row
columns.description: Tautobase 'Row Nr' of the pair; the join key to the original analysis files (unique)

columns.name: heavy1
columns.description: heavy-atom count of tautomer 1 (both tautomers have the same formula in this subset)

columns.name: solvent
columns.description: State/Solvent field of Tautobase for the measurement (empty = not recorded)

columns.name: exp_dom
columns.description: experimentally dominant tautomer, T1 or T2 (direction: SMIRKS T1>>T2, logK = log10([T2]/[T1]), logK > 0 means T2)

columns.name: exp_src
columns.description: evidence class of exp_dom; all 150 pairs carry a numeric logK

columns.name: logK_num
columns.description: experimental logK = log10([T2]/[T1])

columns.name: dG_exp_kcal
columns.description: experimental G(T2) - G(T1) = -1.3642 * logK at 298.15 K

columns.name: in_dft24
columns.description: True if the pair belongs to the 24-pair DFT subset (the smallest water-only pairs)

columns.name: rdkit_score_t1
columns.description: RDKit TautomerEnumerator.ScoreTautomer of tautomer 1 (integer-valued)

columns.name: rdkit_score_t2
columns.description: RDKit TautomerEnumerator.ScoreTautomer of tautomer 2 (integer-valued)

columns.name: rdkit_status
columns.description: correct / wrong / tie: the higher-scored tautomer against exp_dom; equal scores are a tie

columns.name: pm6_dE_kcal
columns.description: gas-phase PM6 heat of formation of T2 minus T1 (positive means T1 is more stable)

columns.name: pm6_status
columns.description: correct / wrong / tie / failed: the lower-energy tautomer against exp_dom

columns.name: gfn2_free_dE_kcal
columns.description: GFN2-xTB + ALPB(water) Gibbs free energy (--ohess) of T2 minus T1; this is the variant behind the manuscript's 30.7% and RMSE 5.4

columns.name: gfn2_free_status
columns.description: correct / wrong / tie / failed for the --ohess variant

columns.name: gfn2_opt_dE_kcal
columns.description: GFN2-xTB + ALPB(water) optimised total energy (--opt) of T2 minus T1; sensitivity variant

columns.name: gfn2_opt_status
columns.description: correct / wrong / tie / failed for the --opt variant

columns.name: dft_dE_kcal
columns.description: wB97X-D/def2-TZVP//def2-SVP + SMD(water) energy of T2 minus T1; empty outside the 24-pair subset

columns.name: dft_status
columns.description: correct / wrong / tie / failed for DFT; empty outside the 24-pair subset

columns.name: t1_smiles
columns.description: SMILES of tautomer 1 as parsed from the Tautobase SMIRKS (atom maps removed)

columns.name: t2_smiles
columns.description: SMILES of tautomer 2 as parsed from the Tautobase SMIRKS (atom maps removed)

null_fields_explained.n_perm: no permutation test is used: McNemar and Fisher tests are exact, the paired CI is Newcombe's closed form plus a multinomial bootstrap

extra.bootstrap_unit: tautomer pair (paired multinomial resampling of the four cell counts)
